title.narrative: MEA III - Component 3 - FAO (AAP 2018)

description.narrative: The primary objective of the programme is to promote environmental sustainability in ACP countries by strengthening environmental governance and the implementation of Multilateral Environmental Agreements (MEAs). The programme will develop and implement integrated approaches to address national biodiversity-related priorities and commitments in agriculture. It will consolidate the progress made in its previous phase in assisting countries in mitigating environmental and social risks associated with the use of highly hazardous pesticides.
